entities.text:
High Court Of Andhra Pradesh
 At Amaravati
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Two Thousand
And Twenty Four
Present
The Honourable Smt Justice Venkata Jyothirmai Pratapa

Criminal Petition No: 8880/2024
Between:
Karukumalli Venkata Subhadramma ...Petitioner/Accused
 And
The State Of Andhra Pradesh and ...Respondent/Complainant(S)
Others Counsel for the Petitioner/accused:
1. T V Jaggi Reddy Counsel for the Respondent/complainant(S):
1. Public Prosecutor
The Court made the following Order

: 
The instant Criminal Petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973 has been filed by the Petitioner/Accused No. 2 seeking quashment of the proceedings in C.C.No.832 of 2021 against him on the file of Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate, Nuzvid, Krishna District registered for the offence punishable under Sections 498A of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of D.P.Act.
2.

entities.text: Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate, Nuzvid, Krishna District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard Sri T.V.Jaggi Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioner.
Ms.K.Priyanka Lakshmi, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor is in attendance.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that this petition may be disposed of dispensing the presence of the petitioner/Accused No.2 before the Trial Court without causing any prejudice to their contentions raised in the present petition.
4. Learned Assistant Public Prosecutor would submit that the court may pass appropriate orders.

sentences.text: 5. Considering the submissions made, the Criminal petition is disposed of.
However, the presence of the petitioner/Accused No.2 before the Trial Court is dispensed with unless his presence is specifically directed by the Trial Court.
Consequently, miscellaneous petitions, pending if any, shall stand closed.
